AgentHostIpcChannels.RemoteProxy.why: patch 0015 gates the agent-host transport by wrapping this channel inside EditorRemoteAgentHostServiceClient, so every caller that instantiates that client is gated (including patch 0010's selection in agentHostService.ts). A second renderer-side consumer would bypass the gate entirely, and no runtime probe can show that none exists.

ExtHostContext.ExtHostDocumentsAndEditor.why: patch 0035 filters which text models reach a tab extension host inside MainThreadDocumentsAndEditors. A second window-side holder of this proxy could push host documents past the filter, and no runtime probe can show that none exists.

ExtHostContext.ExtHostDocuments).why: patch 0035: model content changes and dirty, save and encoding events reach a tab only through MainThreadDocuments, whose ModelTracker and file events apply the same provenance filter. A second window-side getProxy of this shape would bypass it.
